## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/alert`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`AlertComponent`](/api/alert/AlertComponent) | Component | A message that stays on the page, such as a failed payment above a form or a notice above a table, tinted by what it means and marked with an icon. |
| [`AlertActionsDirective`](/api/alert/AlertActionsDirective) | Directive | Marks an element inside `<mona-alert>` as its row of actions, such as a Retry button. |
| [`AlertIconTemplateDirective`](/api/alert/AlertIconTemplateDirective) | Directive | Apply to an `<ng-template>` directly inside `<mona-alert>` to draw the alert's icon in place of the one its look shows. |

### Types

| Type | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`ALERT_DEFAULT_MESSAGES`](/api/alert/ALERT_DEFAULT_MESSAGES) | Constant |  |
| [`AlertAnnouncement`](/api/alert/AlertAnnouncement) | Type alias | How an alert is read aloud when it's shown: not at all, after what's being read, or at once. |
